lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: fix(scripts): GUI runs share one machine-wide lock and bench kills hung runs
lines.text: Emulator config and storage live in `~/.vitadeck/vita3k` (`VITADECK_VITA3K_HOME`), shared by every worktree. Launching waits for the machine-wide GUI lock (`scripts/gui-run.sh`) that `scripts/bench.sh` and `cmake --build out --target run` also take, so one VitaDeck window runs at a time; copying the emulator home doesn't sidestep it. `fs/` in there is the emulated Vita: `ux0/data/vitadeck` is the VitaDeck Data Root, `ur0/data` holds the shader compiler. Run `scripts/vita3k.sh help` for the environment variables.

lines.text: ## Set up a new machine

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: docs(emulator): the Vita build needs Node 24.16+
lines.text: 1. Install the Vita build prerequisites: Node.js 24.16+ (`.nvmrc`), pnpm, Docker (see `vitadeck-build`). `scripts/vita3k.sh` uses `docker compose`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: 2. Install Vita3K:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - macOS: download the dmg from [vita3k.org](https://vita3k.org) for your CPU (Intel or Apple silicon) and drag `Vita3K.app` to Applications.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Windows: `winget install Vita3K.Vita3K`, then run the script from Git Bash. If Vita3K isn't on PATH, set `VITA3K` to `Vita3K.exe`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Linux: download the AppImage, `chmod +x` it, and set `VITA3K` to it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: 3. Install `libshacccg.suprx`. vitaGL compiles its shaders at runtime with Sony's shader compiler, which can't be redistributed, so it isn't in the repo and the script won't launch without it. Use one of:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Copy it from a machine that already runs VitaDeck in Vita3K: `scp <machine>:.vitadeck/vita3k/fs/ur0/data/libshacccg.suprx /tmp/ && scripts/vita3k.sh shacccg /tmp/libshacccg.suprx`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Download it from the Vita: run [ShaRKBR33D](https://github.com/Rinnegatamante/ShaRKBR33D) on the Vita once (it extracts the decrypted module to `ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx`), start VitaShell's FTP server, then `PSVITAIP=<ip> scripts/vita3k.sh shacccg`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: 4. Optional: install the firmware. VitaDeck runs without it; it only provides the CA list that `fetch` reads (fetch still fails, see below). `Vita3K --firmware PSVUPDAT.PUP` installs into Vita3K's default storage and ignores our config, so move `os0` and `vs0` from there into `~/.vitadeck/vita3k/fs/` afterwards. On macOS that is `~/Library/Application Support/Vita3K/Vita3K/fs`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: 5. `scripts/vita3k.sh`. The first launch installs the VPK; the Demo Deck App should appear.

lines.text: - Click the Vita3K window once before sending keys. Keys sent while it is merely frontmost are dropped.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Hold each key for about 60 ms. Longer holds trigger VitaDeck's D-pad repeat and overshoot the focus.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - The VitaDeck log is in the terminal as `export_sceClibVprintf` lines. An access violation at `0x80` logged at startup is harmless.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: feat(dev): run the Vita build in the Vita3K emulator
lines.text: - Runtime Upload works: open Upload in the Shell, then `vitadeck dev http://127.0.0.1:8787/` or `curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/upload -F archive=@<app>.vdapp.zip` from the same machine.
